# ms: # The three events of a first session in a project with no thread to restore,
# and the whole evidence for this port's one correction to upstream's mapping.
# session_id records only whether the payload named the PLACEHOLDER Mastra Code
# constructs its hook manager with, or a real thread; never the id itself.
# SessionStart carries the placeholder. So does UserPromptSubmit, which is the
# surprising half: the thread is not created until the prompt is on its way, so
# the earliest event that can name the conversation at all is AgentStart. It does,
# and the id it carries is the one the TUI printed as `Created thread:` in the same
# run.
# Herdr binds on SessionStart. On this release that binds the string
# "session-init", identically on every machine, and Sidecar marks a reference from
# an official source resumable. So the binding is on AgentStart instead, which also
# re-binds a pane whose thread changed under /new. mastracode.go carries the
# mechanism: createMastraCode passes the literal "session-init", only a
# thread_created/thread_changed subscription replaces it, and MastraTUI.run
# dispatches SessionStart immediately after init.
# A session RESUMED into an existing thread does carry the real id on SessionStart,
# because the restore fires thread_changed during init. That is why the placeholder
# is not visible unless the capture starts from a project with no history, and why
# a binding on SessionStart alone would have looked correct in casual testing.
